description.value:
Duration constant

Your ranged Strikes against adjacent creatures ignore all resistances and all immunities to physical damage, and reduce the target's Hardness to 0. Against an adjacent creature, a Strike that would be a success is a critical success on a natural 19 or 20.

cinderfall.incomplete: checked DamageAlteration's valid property values (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/damage-alteration/rule-element.ts:20-27): only damage-type, dice-faces, dice-number, tags. No "ignore resistance" or "ignore Hardness" property exists, and a compendium-wide grep for ignoreResistance/ignoredResistances returned zero hits anywhere in pf2e-source/packs. The natural-19 crit-range clause also has no selector that restricts an expanded crit threshold to adjacency alone (the real "keen" property is a permanent, unconditional weapon-trait ItemAlteration).
